about: Layer manifest for the outline master records. One entry per agency layer: its URL, the areas it covers, and the EXPECTED COUNT = the total the layer itself reported (returnCountOnly=true) on 2026-11-10 when a live read was allowed. A short read never changes it. Layers that could not be counted under the host and robots rules have no expected_count. caches = official expected totals for the saved copies the key builders read. US-XX uses the live key file counts.padus (the published record count; US-FL is 21993, not the 5198 index row). W-CC uses the live key file counts.areas. CA-ALL has no baseline: no live key file stores a published outline-record total (province files hold park join counts, not cache recs). A saved copy with no baseline is held and not used.

US-MI.dnrsf.agency: Michigan DNR Forest Inventory compartments, dissolved by state forest (FMU key: DNR stumpage reports)
US-MI.dnrsf.note: KPC owner, 2026-11-11: Michigan DNR Forest Inventory compartments (a person's download, EPSG:4326, 2,464 records; sha256 4f1c3bb6f116...) dissolved by state forest through the forest management unit (FMU) code. The FMU-to-forest key is official: Michigan DNR timber stumpage price reports (michigandnr.com, e.g. '2025 Stumpage Price Reports, 12 Months/3rd_Qtr_July_2025.pdf'; FMU 12 from the January 2023 report): Copper Country 11, 12; Escanaba River 32, 33; Lake Superior 41, 42, 45; Mackinaw 52, 53, 54; Pere Marquette 61, 63; Au Sable 71, 72, 73 (2,016 compartments). Left out: the 5-digit 80xxx/90xxx units (no official name), FMU 0 and no FMU (448 records, data/outlines/solver-queue/US-MI.dnrsf-left-out.csv). No ManagementType/District/County guess is used. Mackinaw State Forest (US-4778): its pin is 1.5 km outside the dissolved compartments, so it is not joined (solver queue). Master only: the layer has no service address the key reads.
